LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_ZannerToobin
Zanner Toobin is a Rock Gnome, first found in the Steel Watch Foundry in Act Three. If the party help to save the kidnapped Gondians in the Iron Throne, he becomes an Attached Follower while progressing through the Foundry.

Involvement

Act Three

If the party have not first travelled to the Iron Throne, Zanner Toobin can be found in the back room of the Steel Watch Foundry. Tanner wears a  Kill Collar, which, in case of fighting against the Banites, must be disabled by deactivating a  Motivator held by one of the Black Gauntlets. He informs them that the Gondians dare not fight back against the Banites for fear of killing the hostages in the Iron Throne. The party can either choose to heed his pleas and free the hostages first, or ignore them and turn all the Gondians hostile.

If the party return after rescuing the hostages, Zanner moves to the main floor of the Foundry and leads an uprising against  Tamia Holzt and her allies. After defeating them, Zanner mentions that he knows a secret passcode to make the foundry self-destruct; the party can either agree to take him with them as a Attached Follower or tell him to flee since they have the  Runepowder Bomb. If Zanner accompanies the party, he aids them in combat until they reach the doors to the control centre, where he senses the power of the Steel Watcher Titan and warns the party that he cannot hope to survive against it. He remains outside the entrance of the control centre until the titan is defeated.

Dialogue

Ambient: Steel Watch Foundry, Lab Level

"I smell death and decay. We're near cadaver preparation, aren't we? Poor bastards are shipped in from all over the Realms. Most come from a fellow called Balthazar by way of Moonrise Towers."

Conversation: Control Centre "Antechamber"
The following lines from Zanner are interspersed between other character dialogue lines.

"Wait, Elevated gyroscopes, triple-set quadropecs. No - it can't be."
"I hear it through the floor - powerful. Indestructible. The ultimate Watcher - the Titan."
"It shames me to admit this but you must face this beast of Gondian folly alone - I would be crushed in an instant."
"When it raises its shields, strike it with every scrap of magic and might you posess - and pray to Gond that it does not fire upon you. Good luck, my friend."

Speak with Dead

Zanner Toobin can be spoken to with  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Gondian Zanner Toobin
      Zanner Toobin... leader of the... Gondians...
  • What is going on here?
    • Gondian Zanner Toobin
      The Banites came... collared us... took our families... forced us to build... the Steel Watchers...
      • Where are your families being held?
        • Gondian Zanner Toobin
          Not in the Foundry...
  • Who designed the Steel Watchers?
    • Gondian Zanner Toobin
      I did... to my eternal shame...
  • How do I destroy the Steel Watch?
    • Gondian Zanner Toobin
      Go the Neurocitor... in the depths of the Foundry... Input code 'Nebelun'... then increase to maximum output...
      • Once I input code 'Nebelun' into the Neurocitor, what do I do?
        • Gondian Zanner Toobin
          Run...

Idle banter

  • Ifran
    We have your designs. We have your methods. We have no more use for you.
  • Zanner Toobin
    We are the greatest engineers in the realm - you need us to maintain the Steel Watch!
  • Ifran
    Beg and scream all you wish. You will die today.
  • Zanner Toobin
    I have an idea - for a new Watcher. One that could flatten the city with a single swing!
  • Ifran
    You are in no position to negotiate, Gondian.
  • Zanner Toobin
    But look at all these unfinished Watchers. You need us!
  • Ifran
    Convenient that you mention this only when you are about to die.
  • Zanner Toobin
    Spare us, and I will begin prototyping the new Watcher. Immediately!

Notes

  • While out of combat, Zanner has minor ambient dialogue for certain parts of the Steel Watch Foundry Lab Level, connecting the Steel Watch foundry's story to certain events and characters from Act Two.
  • Zanner's blindness is distinct from  Blinded and cannot be directly cured. In addition,  Lesser Restoration cannot be cast on him if he is not also  Diseased,  Poisoned,  Paralysed, or  Blinded. However, if his particular form of blindness is overridden by another which shares the same StackID (e.g., from an  Arrow of Darkness or  Darkness), clearing the newly acquired source of blindness removes the condition altogether - though he retains his blindfold.

Bugs

  • While an attached follower, Zanner Toobin can be instructed to deactivate a  Motivator. Doing so will cause him consume his action but will not deactivate the motivator.
